summary: Receives tracking data from CAST BlackTrax motion tracking systems, outputting beacon position, rotation, velocity, acceleration, centroid, and LED channels.
key_concepts: Receives RTTrPM packet data from an external BlackTrax system and exposes tracked beacon channels inside TouchDesigner.
Each BlackTrax beacon has an ID from the BlackTrax software, so stable TD channel layout depends on either a Mapping Table or incremental Max Beacons output.
Output Format chooses between rows in the Mapping Table and a fixed Max Beacons count, which changes how many beacon channel groups are created.
Centroid, Velocity, Acceleration, and LEDs toggles let planners limit the channel surface to only the tracking data needed for the patch.
Server-side WYSIWYG coordinates and Euler rotations are the documented expected BlackTrax configuration for TouchDesigner reception.

key_params.note: Maximum beacon count when not using a mapping table

common_gotchas: BlackTrax CHOP is TouchDesigner Pro only and requires a functioning external BlackTrax system.
Port, protocol, and network address must match the tracking server configuration.
Mapping tables are important for stable channel naming when beacon counts or identities matter.
High-rate tracking data can produce many channels; limit outputs to centroid, velocity, LEDs, or acceleration only when needed.
